name: rfs-discord-bridge
description: External Discord → Scrap Mechanic vote drop for Recipe Framework Survival Streamer mode. Lua cannot HTTP; this process writes a local JSON inbox.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');for (const f of ['vote.json','vote_result.json','chat.jsonl','chat_inbox.json','chat_outbox.json']){const p=path.join('inbox',f);try{fs.unlinkSync(p);console.log('Removed',p)}catch(e){console.log('No',f,'to remove')}}"
